{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that deduplication worked: should now be 800 unique patients
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f"Expected 800 unique patients, got {len(df_dedup)}"

# Compute response rate by site
table = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].agg(['mean', 'count']).round(3)
table.columns = ['response_rate', 'n_patients']
print(table)"}
